description: This file defines a class CommonMarkConverter that extends functionality for converting Markdown content to HTML, specifically integrating with the CommonMark PHP library and customizing extensions and renderers.

classes.name: CommonMarkConverter
classes.description: A custom converter class that extends the base Markdown conversion capabilities, integrating specific extensions and renderers for enhanced Markdown features like headings, table of contents, fenced code blocks, and images.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes configuration options for heading permalinks and table of contents before calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: extendEnvironment
methods.description: Extends the CommonMark environment by adding extensions for heading permalinks and table of contents, and registers custom renderers for table of contents, fenced code blocks, and images.
